title: Select nonplanar optical routes late on common embossed stock
statement: Proposed process: emboss common CYTOP relief on silicon, deposit conformal2um Parylene-C, project route masks, etch unwanted film, add identical ports/package. Parallel field exposure changes the route by2D mask after3D stock exists. Ten layouts REPORTED:75.33-90.78um length,13.27-14.12um minimum actual3D bend radius,5.12-5.99um excursion,maxcore36.03x34.01x8.02um. Not2um-bend qualification, arbitrary3D routing or demonstrated new capability. Geometry/model files uncollected.
